LESSON: SPECIFIC MORNING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Specific morning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Specific morning. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
